payload.scientific_problem: test whether the unchanged integrated COMPOSE controller transfers from JAK2 development to the structurally distinct BRAF delta=0.6 repair regime
payload.primary_model_output: a target-reward-adapted selection over the union of complete executable shallow, anchored-replacement, and leave-BRAF-out route-distilled programs
payload.central_claim_under_test: the same multi-expert FiberControl algorithm can autonomously allocate docking calls on BRAF without BRAF-specific controller changes
payload.experimental_setting: prospective three-cell BRAF delta=0.6 cross-target development transfer; fixed 49-call ceiling per cell; candidate exhaustion and abstention are valid outcomes

frozen_from.forbidden_changes: proposal families, proposal widths, FiberControl features or fitting, expert-floor schedule, parent selection, exploration, endpoint gates, call budget, retries, or per-cell tuning

declared_support.objects: complete connected molecular endpoints produced by three executable COMPOSE proposal experts
declared_support.endpoint_support: compose_valid is a strict subset of the official T4 endpoint fiber

zero_oracle_route_support.result: complete-region programs committed on all three cells at precision 1.0, but zero strict-eligible route endpoints on all three cells
zero_oracle_route_support.interpretation: preserved as a failed route-yield gate; the transfer run is authorized to measure the frozen algorithm including abstention, not to relabel this gate as passing

promotion_criteria.transfer_signal: at least two cells reach their reported IVG delta=0.6 mean or one cell beats it by at least 0.5 while a second improves on its measured root
promotion_criteria.negative: two or more cells exhaust without an eligible non-root candidate, or all cells remain no better than their measured roots

payload.primary_baselines: read-only measured roots and reported IVG delta=0.6 values; no comparator value enters runtime
payload.claim_boundary: frozen cross-target BRAF development transfer under one docking seed; route prior excludes BRAF, but the anchored expert was developed from answer-known JAK2 evidence; not held-out benchmark-wide evidence or a same-generator causal ablation
